authorization: User approved all-history, 12-month and 6-month training windows with 2-month predictions. New bounded budget extends prior exhausted 20 fits.
window_definition: Rolling lower bound is validation start minus calendar training months, inclusive. Training label_end must be strictly before validation start. This excludes approximately final 48 hours inside each nominal training window.
model: Same unregularized median regression on standardized values plus missing flags, QuantileRegressor(alpha=0, quantile=0.5, solver=highs). Training-only median imputation/scaling.
fit_accounting: 21 model/window combinations minus 2 identical cached expanding fits = 19 new fits; session cumulative 39 including earlier 20. Failures count; no unregistered retries.
selection: Lowest pooled MAE on identical 18481 development origins. Compare against frozen MP0004, original 3-month expanding schedule and 2-month expanding control.
last_window: Partial final window 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-22 inclusive; retained for exact population equality.
stopping_rule: Run only registered histories; preserve all results and diagnose uncertainty. No further automatic search.
